conf.description: syslog-relay/syslog-ng-stats syslog-kv: parses the internal() 'Log statistics;' message (repeated counter='object(id)=value' pairs on one line) into a nested per-object syslog_ng.stats map, computing written before renaming header fields.

conf.comment: syslog-ng internal() periodic stats message. One line covers every configured object; per parsing.notes the payload is repeated key='object(id)=value' pairs, distinct from the syslog-ng-ctl semicolon table (see api-pull pipeline). This encoding carries no separate instance/state column - see README gap.
